description: Fields of one invoice, copied exactly as printed.

buyer.description: Party the invoice is addressed to (customer, bill to).

address.description: Full postal address on one line, as printed.

name.description: Company or person name as printed.

tax_id.description: VAT ID, EIN or other tax identifier exactly as printed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, JPY.

due_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) as printed, or null.

iban.description: IBAN exactly as printed, including spaces.

invoice_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) as printed, or null.

line_items.description: Printed line items in document order; empty if none.

amount.description: Amount as printed, as a number with a dot decimal separator; null if not printed.

quantity.description: Quantity as printed; null if not printed.

unit_price.description: Amount as printed, as a number with a dot decimal separator; null if not printed.

subtotal.description: Amount as printed, as a number with a dot decimal separator; null if not printed.

supplier.description: Party that issued the invoice (seller, sender).

address.description: Full postal address on one line, as printed.

name.description: Company or person name as printed.

tax_id.description: VAT ID, EIN or other tax identifier exactly as printed.

tax_amount.description: Amount as printed, as a number with a dot decimal separator; null if not printed.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate in percent as printed, e.g. 19 for 19 %.

total.description: Amount as printed, as a number with a dot decimal separator; null if not printed.
